assumptions.billingUnits: Published per-minute container CPU/RAM/volume prices; GB conversion 2^30 bytes
assumptions.backup: Two hypothetical full copies priced at volume rate; no configured backup system or actual backup invoice
assumptions.network: Measured/estimated business JSON plus 32KiB protocol allowance per workflow and 2KiB per extra provider attempt; not vendor-measured TLS egress
assumptions.plan: Full dedicated account minimum allocated to this runtime, hosting credits applied once. This selects no host/plan.
assumptions.inference: Zero required backend inference. Landlord agent subscription, SMS numbers/carrier fees and door hardware excluded. Paid-model sensitivity is hypothetical.
assumptions.retention: No automatic archive deletion exists; history-month values are forecast horizons, not enacted retention policies

limitations: Local scripted lifecycles and injected providers are not live Grok or vendor performance
Billed container memory, filesystem cache, real egress and invoices require hosting measurements
Source hashes identify the runtime version loaded by the long-running fleet sampler, before later hosted-test integration edits
Additive idle+active CPU is conservative; CPU stress multipliers that exceed one average CPU need another capacity design
Request payload mix, bursts, support, human review labor, reservation providers and external account-system costs are not measured
Model accuracy depends on explicit prices and demand assumptions; arithmetic tests do not establish a production operating guarantee
